name: CNET

sources.title: About CNET — consumer-tech reviews publication; press team contact press@cnet.com; affiliate/marketing contacts listed
CNET contact URL — resolves to the About page (no public submission form)

requirements: Not a directory — coverage is earned editorial; there is no submission form or paid listing product on the public site
CNET is a consumer-tech reviews/news publication (Ziff Davis family); staff select and test the products they cover
Press/media inquiries route to press@cnet.com; affiliate partnerships and marketing have separate contact paths on the About page
Realistic path for a SaaS: get reviewed — pitch the editorial team with a consumer-relevant product, or become an affiliate partner if the product fits their commerce model
preparation: A consumer-facing tech angle — CNET covers consumer electronics, software/services, home internet, streaming, AI tools
Press kit: what the product does, pricing, screenshots, review access credentials, launch date
A named editor/reporter covering your category (meet-the-experts page lists staff beats)
workflow: Identify the relevant CNET beat and reporter from the About/experts pages
Send the pitch or press release to press@cnet.com or the reporter directly
For review coverage, offer hands-on access — CNET Labs does hands-on testing
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article or review — no listing page is created
Alternative route: affiliate partnership inquiry via the 'Contact us' links on the About page if the product suits deals/reviews commerce content
watchFor: press@cnet.com is framed for expert commentary requests — a pure launch announcement may land better with a specific beat reporter
Affiliate/commerce coverage is commission-driven; editorial reviews are not pay-to-play
No self-serve listing exists — anyone selling a 'CNET listing' is not offering a real route
Embargo norms: agree on embargo terms before sending details
countsAsLive: A CNET article/review mentioning the product is published at cnet.com
unknowns: Which individual inbox is best for product-launch pitches — no dedicated tips address was found
Whether CNET still runs any contributed-content program — none found on public pages
